title: Samba packages must be removed from AIX.
check_content:
Run the following command to check if samba packages are installed on AIX:
# lslpp -l samba*

If the above command shows that samba packages are installed, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Run the following command to un-install the samba packages:
# installp -ug samba*
VulnDiscussion: If the smbpasswd file has a mode more permissive than 0600, the smbpasswd file may be maliciously accessed or modified, potentially resulting in the compromise of Samba accounts.
